profile.name: Bob
profile.overview: Bob is a fast and explosive Mishima-style character. His toolkit appeals to a lot of different playstyles; a crouchdash giving him good mobility and mixup options, strong counter hit tools, a plethora of string extensions, and some powerful moves in heat.
profile.playstyle: A heavyweight Mishima-style fighter. Crouch dash (f,n,d,df) into the Electric-style Langue Washer, hellsweep and mids; use his Balance (BAL) stance and big counter-hit tools. Fast and explosive, but his big hurtbox and execution demands mean you must stay sharp on the inputs.
strengths: The Biggest Mishima: Sports all the tools of a Mishima despite not actually being one: 1,1,2, crouchdash, hellsweep, electric wind bob fist, demon paw heat engager
Jabber: Very strong pokes with good range, including some of the best lows in the game
Burn My Fat!: Has some extremely powerful heat moves, including a counter hit launching low hatchet kick, a 12 frame punish that floor breaks, and a just frame heat smash that deals 60 damage
Roar My Fists!: Excellent block and whiff punishment up until i15
weaknesses: Big Boy: His perfect physique comes at the cost of a bigger-than-average hurtbox
Tough To Digest: As with any Mishima, he requires quite a bit of skill to use effectively
Slow Cooker: His fastest standing launcher (not counting perfect CD1) starts at i17
Combo Breaker: His combos are pretty inconsistent overall, and his optimal routes require precise micro-dashes, crouch cancels and blue spark inputs

stances.name: Crouch Dash
stances.note: His Mishima-style dash: CD.1 (f,n,d,df+1) is an i13 high that instantly tornadoes on hit, CD.4-style hellsweep (f,n,d,DF+4) is a stagger low.

stances.name: Balance
stances.note: BAL.1,2 is a Heat Engager and +1 on block; BAL.3 is +4 on block. Several moves transition here with F.

heat: Can use à la Carte moves (f+2,H.1+2,1, H.df+3+4, uf+1,2,H.2, BAL.1,H.4)

sources.note: Community-maintained frame data. Values can lag behind the latest patch; verify in Practice mode frame display.

keyMoves.summary: i10 jab string, -12 on block if all three finish.
keyMoves.counterplay: Block, then punish the last hit.
keyMoves.afterBlock: 1,1 alone is safer; the full string is -12.

keyMoves.use: To make the opponent respect mids.

keyMoves.summary: Bite Uppercut: i14 mid, -8 on block, slight jab evasion.
keyMoves.purpose: A mid that can duck under jabs.
keyMoves.use: When the opponent likes to jab you.
keyMoves.avoid: Expecting it to keep the turn.
keyMoves.gamePlan: His tool against button presses up close.

keyMoves.summary: Langue Washer (CD.1): i13 high, -4 on block, instant tornado on hit.
keyMoves.purpose: His electric-style launcher: fast, safe and huge.
keyMoves.use: In neutral and as a whiff punish from crouch dash.
keyMoves.afterHit: Instant tornado: go into his tornado BnB.
keyMoves.gamePlan: The move to practise: it is his best tool.

keyMoves.summary: Abats Snipe: i17 mid launcher, strong jab evasion, -13 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: His evasive launcher and i17 punisher.
keyMoves.use: Punish -17 moves; duck under jabs and launch.
After blocking lows that are -14 or worse.
keyMoves.avoid: On block the second hit is -20.

keyMoves.summary: Shrimp Turnover: i19 mid, instant tornado on counter hit (+73a).
Gaufrettes Punch: high string, +1 on block, launches on counter hit.
keyMoves.purpose: A plus-on-block high string with a CH launch.

keyMoves.summary: Hellsweep: i18 stagger low, -28 on block.
keyMoves.use: Out of crouch dash once the opponent respects CD.1.
keyMoves.gamePlan: The low half of his crouch-dash mix-up.

keyMoves.summary: Liaison Spike: i20 low, -12 on block, +14g on counter hit.
Spicy Ring: Heat Engager string, -13 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: One of his Heat Engagers and an i13 punisher.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Use as a punish to start Heat.

keyMoves.summary: Cooler Shaker: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.

combos.name: CD.1 tornado BnB
combos.situation: After a tornado launch such as CD.1 (f,n,d,df+1).
combos.route: T! f,F+3~DF CD.1 df+1 b+4,3~F BAL.1,2
mistakes: Doing the crouch dash too slowly: f,n,d,df is one smooth motion.
Pressing BAL.1,2 before the F input has put him in Balance.

combos.name: f,F+3 → b+3
mistakes: Following up when f,F+3 was blocked.
